quote: const res = await fetch("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(lines) });
title: A network failure on Send or Void is an unhandled rejection: the user sees nothing, and the Send guard stays armed
evidence: Only !res.ok is handled (app.js:27, :34). fetch rejects when the network fails, and there is no try/catch. Driven offline: pageerror 'Failed to fetch', no alert, no message. tooSoon() has already set lastSend, so a retry within 1 s is silently swallowed too.
failing_case: Go offline (or the server drops the connection), click Send invoice: nothing visible happens. The user cannot tell whether the invoice went out. The same applies to Void.
remediation: Wrap both calls in try/catch. Show a persistent inline error saying the request did not reach the server and that the user can retry. Set the in-flight state in a finally block.

title: Send has no in-flight guard, no success feedback and does not clear the lines, so one invoice is easily sent twice
evidence: app.js:25-28 relies on tooSoon() (guards.js:21), a 1-second timer, not on request state. The button is never disabled. On success the only effect is sentCount += 1, which nothing reads. lines is never cleared and nothing is shown. Driven with Playwright against a local server that delays the first POST by 2 s: clicks at 0 s and 1.5 s produced two POSTs to /api/invoices.
failing_case: Click Send invoice on a slow connection (response takes over 1 s), see nothing happen, click again at 1.1 s: the same invoice is posted twice. After a fast success, nothing says it was sent and the lines stay, so a user who clicks again 1 s later posts a duplicate.
remediation: Disable the button while the request is pending and ignore re-entry until it settles. On success show a visible confirmation and clear or lock the lines. Send an idempotency key so the server can reject duplicates.

quote: const total = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.qty * l.price, 0);
title: Total is summed from unrounded float prices while each line shows a price rounded to 2 places, so the displayed lines do not add up to the displayed total
evidence: Price is stored as typed (app.js:18, :20) and only rounded when displayed (app.js:8). The money rule lives in render, in floating point, with no rounding to cents. Driven: lines 1 x 5.00 and 3 x 1.00 (price 1.005) display a total of 8.02 where the lines show 8.00. The unrounded 1.005 is what is posted to the server.
failing_case: Add a line with price 1.005 and quantity 3: the row reads '3 x 1.00' but the total contributes 3.02. The invoice total contradicts its own lines, and the server receives sub-cent prices.
remediation: Round unit price to cents (or use integer minor units) when the line is accepted. Compute line and invoice totals in one pure, tested function, and have render only display its result.

title: A whitespace-only client passes the required attribute, is trimmed to empty and is added as a line with an empty link
evidence: required (index.html:14) accepts ' '. After trim() the value is empty and is never rechecked before lines.push (app.js:20). Driven: the row rendered as : 1 x 5.00, an invisible, focusable, nameless link.
failing_case: Type spaces in Client, quantity 1, price 5, press Add line: a priced line with no client name is added and goes into the invoice.
remediation: Check the trimmed client is non-empty before pushing, and show an error on the field.

title: Invalid quantity or price is rejected silently, and Infinity is accepted as a price
evidence: The early return gives no message and does not mark the field. Number("Infinity") > 0 is true, so the price check passes: driven with price 'Infinity', the total became 'Infinity', and JSON.stringify posts null for it. Number('1e3') is accepted too. Empty or non-numeric price fails with no feedback.
failing_case: Type 'abc' as the price and press Add line: nothing happens. Type 'Infinity': a line is added and the total reads Infinity.
remediation: Use Number.isFinite and a decimal-format check for price. Show an inline error naming the field and the accepted format, and set aria-invalid on it.

title: Send invoice with no lines posts an empty invoice
evidence: No check that lines is non-empty before the POST. Driven on a fresh page: a POST to /api/invoices with body '[]' went out.
failing_case: Open the page and click Send invoice: an empty invoice is posted and, with a 200, nothing is shown.
remediation: Disable Send until at least one line exists, or block it with a message saying to add a line first.

title: Void invoice is a dead control for every non-admin: it is shown enabled and silently does nothing; the permission is enforced only in the browser
evidence: user is a hard-coded object with roles ["viewer","billing"] (app.js:2), so canVoid (guards.js:10-12) is always false. Driven: clicking Void sent no request and showed no message. The button at index.html:24 is always enabled and visible. The only authorisation check is client-side. The request at app.js:33 carries no invoice id and no credentials-bound payload, so if the server trusts the caller the check is bypassed from the console.
failing_case: A billing user clicks Void invoice: nothing happens and no reason is given. A user who calls fetch('/api/invoices/void', {method:'POST'}) from the console skips the canVoid check entirely.
remediation: Enforce the admin rule on the server for /api/invoices/void. In the UI, hide or disable the button for non-admins with a visible reason, and add a confirm step plus the invoice id for the destructive action.

title: Every client name is a link to '#' that does nothing, and the whole list is rebuilt inside an aria-live region on each add
evidence: The anchors have no destination: they are keyboard stops that jump to the top of the page and have no handler. The title repeats the visible text. render() replaces ul#lines.innerHTML (app.js:7), and the ul has aria-live=polite (index.html:21), so a screen reader re-announces every line each time one is added. There is no way to remove a line.
failing_case: Tab through the page after adding 5 lines: 5 links that do nothing take focus. With a screen reader, adding line 6 announces all 6.
remediation: Render the client as plain text, and add a real remove button per line if a control is needed. Append only the new row, or announce a short status message in a separate live region.
